feeds.title: 'Ebola is like Covid pandemic': African CDC chief says no country in the world is safe now
feeds.summary: Comparing with Covid, Kaseya said many countries thought they are safe when Covid started. “We shouldn’t forget that at the beginning of Covid, many countries said there was zero risk of being affected, but a few months later, they became the hotspot,” he said. “We don’t want to see the UK and other countries become the hotspot.”

feeds.title: Youth should lead nationwide campaign against tobacco use: Union Minister Prataprao Jadhav
feeds.summary: The 60-day Tobacco-Free Youth campaign was launched at the Atal Bihari Vajpayee Institute of Medical Sciences and Dr RML Hospital here, a health ministry statement said.

feeds.title: Fortis acquires 110-bed Suguna Hospital in Bengaluru
feeds.summary: The acquisition was undertaken by Fortis’ wholly-owned subsidiary International Hospital Limited (IHL) with the transaction being completed on October 28.

feeds.title: HUL backs FSSAI labelling norms for food products high in fat, salt
feeds.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has proposed front-of-pack nutrition labelling for packaged food products high in sugar, salt or fat, seeking to enable consumers to make informed dietary choices.

feeds.title: Advertising Standards Council flags misleading claims in nutraceutical ads
feeds.summary: In its report, ‘A Pill for Thought: Review of Health and Wellness Claims in Nutraceutical Advertising’ based on the suo-motu investigation of nutraceutical ads between July and September 2026, the council said ads may lead consumers to be misled about the benefits of nutraceutical products, particularly those that highlight time-bound results and representations.

feeds.title: New national air pollution standards wait as review drags on for 5 yrs
feeds.summary: The reply, dated Oct 26, said National Ambient Air Quality Standards (NAAQS) notified in 2009 continue to apply across the country while a revised report from IIT Kanpur remains under review by a steering committee which was constituted by CPCB on May 6, 2020.

feeds.title: Indira IVF in talks to acquire Sabine in nearly Rs 1,300 crore deal
feeds.summary: The proposed transaction is likely to value CX Partners-owned Sabine at ₹1,200-1,300 crore, said the people. CX Partners had acquired about 54% stake in Sabine in 2024 at a valuation of $100 million (about ₹835 crore).

feeds.title: Centrally sponsored insurance must be periodically revised: Fortis MD
feeds.summary: This comes a year after the Union health ministry revised rates for nearly 2,000 procedures under the Central Government Health Scheme in October 2025, the first major revamp since 2014.
